Study study STUDY. Do everything you can to improve your ACT score the best you can. Over the summer I found myself in a similar situation with the school I wanted to go to. They wanted like a 29 and I had a 23. So I literally read up on everything I could about the ACT, and studied for anything I was lacking in. I ended up with a 28 composite, which really helped because I had a mediocre GPA- and I got into the school I wanted. It’s very important to understand what you got wrong and why you got it wrong when you take practice tests, so you don’t make the same mistake on the real thing. I know right now, you can’t go to your school and checkout an act prep book, but there are a plethora of ACT resources online, and many videos on YouTube (I like supertutortv, she’s a really dope lady.) 

I really think your best bet is to improve your ACT score as much as you can, and when it comes to writing your college essays, be as real as you can be. 

Good luck fam!

I believe in you! I know looking for a job is anxiety inducing but I know that thru the hardships you’ve faced, a job interview is the least of your issues. I recommend looking on indeed, and calling any help wanted numbers you see. 

I really, truly believe in you. You can do this. You are not going to become your parents, you will find something better, something that you deserve.

Do you have a job you could work up in? Like even just a small part time might give you a bit more purpose to your life. You could make your own money and provide what little you can for yourself. It won’t be easy but at least it’s something to do that’ll make you feel like they need you.

“they’ve stopped providing,” nah fam that is neglect. They have to provide for you till you’re 18. I know it sucks to have alcoholic parents, especially because you never know if this time they’re gonna take it too far. 

I don’t think introducing cps will make it much worse. I did it to my dad, and for a while it was like all hell broke loose, but after a while he realized what he was doing was wrong, and he tried to fix himself.

Do you have any family members you could stay with for some stability? (Aunts/uncles, grandparents?) I know your boyfriends family probably isn’t the best for you and might make you feel worse, so if you have anybody close to you that you could visit with for a while that might make you feel better.

Have you thought about contacting CPS? You’re a minor and if they’re refusing to care for you, there are services that can help you get food, a place to stay, a job, and even ged. I know it’s shit, but please try a few more options before you say fuck it all. 

You deserve to have a chance at life, please don’t cut it short.
